verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms an official Agent SDK exists and is used for TypeScript applications (letta-gh-1), and generic 'agent-sdk' docs pages exist (letta-docs-1/11), but nothing in the pack explicitly documents a Python SDK or states that memory APIs are equivalent across languages. Missing for 10: explicit Python SDK docs/package, explicit cross-language memory API parity documentation, independent confirmation of both SDKs.
